# Taxline

> Agentic tax operations. Five AI agents (Relay intake, Lens extraction, Atlas research, Ledger workpapers, Sentry compliance) work behind an orchestrator. Every field carries a confidence score and a citation; fields under 0.85 confidence route to a person, and a human approves before any output ships. Taxline does not file autonomously and does not train on client data. The tax math is implemented twice, in TypeScript and in Python on exact decimals, and a parity test compares the two to the cent. Educational project on synthetic data; not tax advice.

## Free tax calculators (tax year 2026, figures from IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32)

- [Federal income tax calculator](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/tools/income-tax/): Form 1040 estimate with brackets, capital gains, QBI, child tax credit, SE tax, NIIT, and a line-by-line trace. Accepts a plain-English description; each extracted field carries a confidence and an evidence quote checked in code before the user approves it.
- [Self-employment tax calculator](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/tools/self-employment-tax/): Schedule SE with the $184,500 wage base and Additional Medicare.
- [Estimated tax calculator](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/tools/estimated-tax/): §6654 safe harbor (90% / 100% / 110%) and the four 1040-ES installments.
- [S corporation election calculator](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/tools/s-corp/): sole proprietor vs. S corp on the same profit, with payroll FICA, QBI, overhead, and a salary sweep.
- [Depreciation calculator](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/tools/depreciation/): §179, bonus, and MACRS schedules with tax-shield present value.
- [Firm ROI calculator](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/tools/roi/): hours returned, payback, NPV, and IRR for a tax practice.

## Product

- [Product](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/product/): the console surfaces.
- [Agents](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/agents/): the fleet and the orchestrator.
- [Methodology](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/methodology/): how the engine computes, rounds, and cites; confidence routing math.
- [Insights](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/insights/): guides on 2026 tax figures and planning, authored in an EmDash CMS.
  - [2026 federal tax brackets and standard deduction, line by line](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/insights/2026-federal-tax-brackets/): The seven 2026 rates, every threshold for every filing status, and the new standard deduction, transcribed from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and checked against the IRS base amounts.
  - [The estimated tax safe harbor, with the math](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/insights/estimated-tax-safe-harbor/): Pay the smaller of 90% of this year's tax or 100% of last year's (110% above $150,000 of AGI), and the underpayment penalty does not apply. Here is how to compute it and when to pay.
  - [When an S corporation election pays: a worked example at $150,000](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/insights/s-corp-election-worked-example/): At $150,000 of profit and a $60,000 salary, the election saves a single filer $7,275.61 in 2026. The reasonable-compensation rule is why the salary is not zero.
  - [Why our agents never do arithmetic](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/insights/why-agents-never-do-arithmetic/): Language models draft and extract. A tested engine computes. A person approves. How Taxline splits the work, and the checks that sit at each boundary.
- [Pricing](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/pricing/)
- [Security](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/security/)
- [Docs](https://patrickking67.github.io/taxline/docs/)

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline): MIT-licensed monorepo with the site, agent service, tax engine, CMS, and contact Worker.
- [README](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/blob/main/README.md): architecture, quick start, and quality signals.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, layout, and conventions for coding agents.
- [Tax engine](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/tree/main/packages/tax-engine): deterministic TY2026 federal math, every figure cited.
- [Agent service](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/tree/main/service): orchestrator, five agents, and the human-approval gate.
- [Quantitative package](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/tree/main/python): taxline_quant, a Decimal TY2026 model with scenario sweeps, seeded Monte Carlo for estimated payments, and an offline extraction evaluation harness.
- [Quantitative report](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/blob/main/docs/quant/report.md): generated rates, what-if tables, payment projections, and calibration results with their assumptions.
- [Constants and sources](https://github.com/patrickking67/taxline/blob/main/docs/quant/constants.md): every TY2026 figure the Python model reads, with its citation.
